newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian budget worth 15.3 trln lire - cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Italian budget worth 15.3 trln lire - cabinet.

text.p: The Italian mini-budget will include around 15.3 trillion lire of deficit cutting measures, cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli said on Wednesday.
The package is expected to be approved at a cabinet meeting on Thursday.
Earlier the leader of Communist Refoundation, Fausto Bertinotti, said the corrective budget would aim to reduce the deficit this year by some 16 trillion lire. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
